text:
anya: noticing ~3x p99 on tokgen for convo workload on canary-3 (us-west). Baseline p99 ~80ms, now ~250ms. Any idea?
kevin: saw alerts. spike lines up w/ commit 4f9b2 that changed batching heuristic (prefer merge even for variable seqs)
frank: perf flame shows big hot on flash_paged_kernel::compute at step 42 — disproportionate time compared to fused_attn
maria: KV cache hit rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.35 on canary-3. logs:
```
KVCache: miss_count=1473 hit_count=771
kernel_select: selected=flashattn_paged_v2 fallback=fused_attn
```
sanjay: interesting — kernel selector started preferring paged variant due to estimated memory < threshold; but paged impl has pathological lock at >64 batch size
kevin: running a quick git bisect across the recent batching changes now
kevin: bisect result: regression introduced at commit 4f6a3f (batching: reduce variance threshold, merge more aggressively, set prefer_paged=true)
anya: what's the observable change in runtime profile?
frank: before/after summary from microbench (same hardware):
- before (pre-4f6a3f): avg_token_latency=2.8ms, p99=78ms
- after (post-4f6a3f): avg_token_latency=6.9ms, p99=248ms
frank: flame snippet shows high mutex contention inside paged allocator and repeated page-table walk penalties
maria: small reproducer for local testing:
```
./perf_runner --model redwood-v2 --seq 1024 --batch 72 --kv_enabled
```
kevin: quick workaround: set ROUTER_PREFER_PAGED=0 in canary env or adjust selector to avoid paged for batch > 64 while kv coldstart rate > 0.5
anya: rolling canary revert? I'd prefer a selector hotfix instead of full revert so we keep other batching gains
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-142 — paging eng-runtime oncall
ci-bot: canary rollback queued for canary-3 (will hold if a hotfix PR lands)
sanjay: assigning to @kevin and @maria to ship selector patch; I'll own rollout verification and perf checks
maria: will add unit test for kv hit heuristic and a small reproducer harness in eng-runtime/tests/perf to catch regressions
kevin: opening PR with selector patch + perf test and perf numbers attached
anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
